declaration.validatorScope: Required declared IDs and selected primary-source bindings only, explicitly not exhaustive upstream coverage or executable compatibility.

inheritedSurfaceLedger.limitation: This is the current machine ledger's declaration, not a fresh aggregate of all November run receipts. IMPLEMENTED_SCOPED and runtime_complete are not whole_surface_admitted.

findings.fact: native_v6_file/native_v6_raft rejects postgres_durable, openbao_wrapper, plugin_auth, plugin_database, plugin_kms, external_kms and plugin_secrets. V6 requires Shamir file custody without these provider adapters.
findings.limit: Other storage/profile implementations and provider code exist in the repository; this finding is the selected scalable V6 profile's exact admission boundary, not a claim that the entire product has no provider implementation.

findings.fact: V6 storage eligibility requires no identity MFA/password policies and empty JWT, Kubernetes, OIDC, LDAP, RADIUS, Kerberos and plugin auth state. Root auth mounts are token/AppRole/cert/userpass; admitted child auth mounts are service-token/AppRole/cert, with further child token-state limits.
findings.limit: The scope is exact V6 eligibility and dispatch. Existing LDAP/RADIUS/etc code, historical runtime tests and the local AppRole/TLS positive tests are preserved.

findings.fact: The root engine eligibility admits KV1/KV2, local Transit without external state, TOTP and PKI's native-local profile. Other backends fail eligibility; non-admitted runtime routes reach the Service 501 gate. SSH mount remains an explicit 501 negative case; database/Kubernetes/OpenLDAP/plugin-backed secret effects cannot be inferred from KV2 tests.
findings.limit: KV1 is supported and the old KV1-refusal test expectation was stale. CI0dc changes only that input to unsupported KV3; the SSH refusal remains.

findings.fact: Transit/TOTP/PKI/root wrapping/capability observations are explicitly root-local. Nonroot routes require one of the named CG/auth/identity/KV/metadata/remount/missing-route owners; anything outside the list is 501.
findings.limit: New scoped namespace31 positive evidence is valid; it does not prove arbitrary nested namespace, full engine composition or per-namespace seal parity.

findings.fact: The native route gate rejects unsupported restore/replication/raft/rekey/raw/migrate owners, with explicit exceptions for the supported native snapshot and Raft observation owners. Separate manual-unseal migrate=true and PGP rekey backup=true responses are explicitly unimplemented.
findings.limit: Do not turn this into a blanket 'all snapshots/rekey absent' claim: route-specific supported snapshot/observation exceptions and nonnative operations must retain their actual scope.

findings.fact: The actual http_native_kv2_large execute calls begin_native_kv2_large_before, which calls begin_request_before and reaches the Service standby 503 before body transfer or peer forwarding. This is the dedicated HeptaBao large-upload route, not all KV traffic.
findings.limit: Ordinary leader forwarding/ReadIndex and leader-local full34 remain valid at their actual scope. The HeptaBao-specific route has no direct OpenBao API comparator.

findings.fact: The 2.7.1 manifest requires exact-candidate executable receipts for all 15 security and 11 feature/correctness deltas. Real KMS/HSM, PostgreSQL/other supported databases, LDAP and other provider-backed surfaces cannot be replaced by in-memory fakes or the AuthBus model provider's credential tests.
findings.limit: OPEN metadata alone is not proof of a missing implementation or a current failing run. Control groups, ML-DSA, PostgreSQL, Pebble and provider code already exist; this audit has not independently admitted their full behavior.

findings.fact: The inherited complete-replacement requirements include all configuration/policy/identity/mount/key-version/lease/revocation assets; quorum-ordered replay retirement without a fixed lifetime ceiling; storage faults and mixed-version rolling upgrade; provenance/dependency/license/security/reproducibility/platform qualification.
findings.limit: They are pre-existing gates, not new requirements invented for this audit. Current HA128, KV2 full34 and real AuthBus lifecycle passes remain useful exact-scope evidence.

findings.fact: Actual deferred HTTP entry obtains NativeSnapshotAdmission before body I/O. Redirect uses actual leader/configured origin and emits HTTP 307; it reads/replays/spools no upload. Existing service tests cover real Raft leader changes, GET/HEAD/POST/PUT, empty/invalid/limited tokens without consumption, no spool/generation mutation, sealed/no-leader failure and original deadline.
findings.limit: The inner Service streaming 503 is not proof of missing snapshot standby redirect. These tests were inspected rather than rerun by this audit; socket-level pinned OpenBao 2.7.1 wire comparison remains a distinct evidence task.
